info.title: VeloGroupsets catalogue API
info.description: Public, read-only curated bicycle groupset and component data. No authentication required. Unknown weights remain null; sources, technical documents and model variants are preserved. Successful GET/HEAD responses are publicly cacheable for 300 seconds. Query parameters must appear only once; unknown parameters are rejected. Trailing slashes are accepted. Community APIs are separate and are not covered by this specification.

weight_g.description: Positive weight in grams for a compliant identified configuration, or explicit null when no compliant weight is sourced.

weight_excludes_skewers.description: Required for front/rear hubs; weights must exclude skewers.

aliases.description: Reserved previous component IDs and slugs merged into this canonical record.

CatalogueVersion.description: SHA-256 of the canonical public catalogue snapshot. Changes when curated records or taxonomy change.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Zero-based offset; offsets beyond the total return an empty page.

Q.name: q
Q.description: Case/accent-insensitive search. Every whitespace-separated term must match. Empty text applies no search.

ManufacturerId.name: manufacturer_id
ManufacturerId.description: Canonical manufacturer ID, such as shimano.

GroupsetId.name: groupset_id
GroupsetId.description: Canonical groupset membership ID, such as shimano-105-r7000.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: ETag validator; weak tags, lists of tags and * are accepted.

Id.name: id
Id.description: Canonical record ID. Component detail requests also accept documented historical ID aliases and return the canonical record.

ETag.description: Entity tag for this representation; usable with If-None-Match.

CacheControl.description: Public successful responses are cached for five minutes.

CatalogueVersion.description: Revision of the curated catalogue; compare this while paging.

ContentLocation.description: Canonical API URI, including when an historical component ID alias is requested.

NotModified.description: The If-None-Match validator matches; no response body.

BadRequest.description: Unknown/repeated query parameter, invalid pagination, excessive search length or unknown filter ID.

NotFound.description: Unknown catalogue endpoint or record ID.

MethodNotAllowed.description: This public data API is read only.

ServerError.description: The catalogue could not be served.
